retrievalProfile.description: A centered steer skull with long horns set against a dark, smoky background, featuring heavily textured western-style display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring a weathered steer skull as the central anchor, framed by atmospheric smoke and high-contrast lighting, topped with ornate, textured serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography layered over the top and bottom of the central icon
Atmospheric smoke providing depth behind the subject
High contrast between the bone-white skull and black background
coreInvariants: Steer skull with prominent horizontal horns
Tooled leather or engraved silver texture within the display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The steer skull is the primary subject, centered and occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central forehead of the skull where the secondary text is placed.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down to the skull, and finish at the bottom Roman numerals.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space at the corners, filled with soft grey smoke to create atmosphere.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bone white and light tan of the skull.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver and grey in the textured typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall, relying on value contrast between light bone and dark void.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast slab serif and heavy sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display type features internal floral engraving patterns
Heavy beveling and drop shadows for a 3D metallic effect
Wide tracking for secondary sans-serif text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized with a smaller, centered loop
Roman numerals feature the same internal engraving as the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, textured slab-serif for the main brand paired with a clean, heavy sans-serif for the specific edition title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and western feel.
Matches the small-cap feel and sturdy presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered, weathered steer skull with long horizontal horns against a black background with wisps of grey smoke at the bottom and sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a beveled, silver-textured slab-serif font at the top. Place the secondary title in a bold, wide-tracked sans-serif across the skull's forehead. Place large Roman numerals with the same silver texture at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have a floral engraving texture?
Is the background dark and smoky?
Is the secondary text placed directly on the skull?

mustRedesign: Exact floral pattern in the letters
Unique cracks in the skull bone

avoid: Flat, untextured colors in the display type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the texture.
Ensure the smoke does not obscure the horns.
Verify the beveled effect on the silver text looks three-dimensional.
Confirm the Roman numerals match the primary title style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central rustic icon + Textured metallic display type + Smoky dark vignette = Western Gothic Aesthetic
